title: Field Defect: Watchdog Reset Loop on SKU-31
text: Units of SKU-31 running FW-4.2.0 entered a reset loop after a cold start below freezing. The fast-boot path introduced in CR-882 skips a sensor settle delay, so the first read returns an out-of-range value and the watchdog fires. Last known good build is FW-4.1.3.
